crudSummary.create: Initiate transaction records across payment channels (credit/debit cards, bank transfer slips, digital wallets, COD) and auto-generate itemized e-invoices with tax breakdowns.
crudSummary.read: Track real-time payment states (Pending, Paid, Failed, Refunded), download official printable PDF tax invoices, and access customer transaction histories.
crudSummary.update: Update transaction status following manual bank slip review or payment gateway webhooks, and record processed refund details.
crudSummary.delete: Void failed or unverified payment attempts, archive obsolete billing records, and cancel invalidated draft invoices.

assignedErrors.name: Credit/Debit Card Decline or Validation Failure
assignedErrors.condition: Triggered when card number length is not 16 digits, contains non-numeric characters, or matches simulated declined test numbers (ending in '0000').
assignedErrors.message: Transaction declined by issuing bank (Insufficient funds or security block).

assignedErrors.name: Missing Bank Deposit Slip or Reference Number
assignedErrors.condition: Triggered when Bank Transfer channel is selected but either deposit transaction reference number or confirmation slip upload is missing.
assignedErrors.message: Bank transfer requires a valid deposit reference number and an uploaded deposit slip image.

assignedErrors.name: Illegal Refund Attempt on Non-Paid Invoice
assignedErrors.condition: Triggered when an administrator or staff attempts to refund an invoice that is not in 'Paid' status (e.g., Pending, Voided, or already Refunded).
assignedErrors.message: Cannot refund invoice. Current payment state is "Pending". Only "Paid" transactions can be refunded.

endpointsTested: POST /api/payments/process - Authorize card, verify slip, or confirm COD
GET /api/invoices - Retrieve all issued tax invoices
GET /api/invoices/:invoiceNo - Fetch single official invoice with warranty and line items
POST /api/invoices/:invoiceNo/refund - Process authorized refund on paid invoices
DELETE /api/invoices/:invoiceNo/void - Void invalidated or draft invoices
